cells.gaps: The 18,900 people of 2024 are registered with a number, but no source says identity documents were issued to them. No source since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.
cells.note: Stage 2: UNHCR had registered 18,900 people in Morocco by the end of 2024, 4,679 of them that year. No source says documents were issued to them, so question 2 is unmet.
